summary.text: Steve Green is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 2 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Green graduated from Fosston High School.
He represented District 2B in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2013 to 2023 and assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on January 3, 2023.
In the 2026 general election Green is on the ballot with Dan Rogers (D) and Calvin Larson Jr. (Unaffiliated); the Republican primary was canceled.
